decisions.choice: Moses went and spoke (the traditional Hebrew text)
alternatives: Moses finished speaking all these words to all Israel (a Dead Sea Scroll and the Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The traditional Hebrew text reads "Moses went and spoke these words". One of the Dead Sea Scrolls of Deuteronomy and the ancient Greek translation read instead "Moses finished speaking all these words to all Israel". In Hebrew the two readings differ only in the order of a few letters. The other reading would make this verse close the speech of chapters 29-30, in the way 31:24 and 32:45 mark an ending. We follow the traditional Hebrew text, which makes the verse introduce the words that follow. This account of the evidence is from general knowledge and must be checked against the textual sources before review.

decisions.choice: went and spoke: set about speaking; these words point ahead to verses 2-6
decisions.reason: The verb "went" often begins a new action without a journey: Moses turns to a new task. In the traditional text "these words" are the words that follow, Moses' farewell charge to the people in verses 2-6.

decisions.choice: all the people of Israel
decisions.reason: "All Israel" means the whole people. Readable says so in plain words.

decisions.choice: the narrator's frame in chapter 31 in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("alla", "dit", "écrivit") and the passé composé at Readable ("est allé", "a écrit"); Moses' and God's speeches use the ordinary spoken tenses at every level
decisions.reason: As in 1:1-5: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative, the passé composé the one young readers use; Readable keeps to it.

decisions.choice: go out and come in: lead the people in war and in their daily life
decisions.reason: The pair of verbs describes a leader's whole work, going out at the head of the people and bringing them back (Numbers 27:17; Joshua 14:11). Moses is not saying that his body has failed, since 34:7 says his strength had not left him. He is saying that his time to lead is over, because God has said he will not cross.

decisions.choice: You shall not cross this Jordan: God's earlier word to Moses
decisions.reason: God refused to let Moses enter the land because of what happened at Meribah (Numbers 20:12), and refused again when Moses pleaded with him (3:23-27; 1:37).

decisions.choice: a son of 120 years: 120 years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being the "son" of so many years.

decisions.choice: go out and come in before you; Readable "lead you"
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the Hebrew pair and adds "before you" to show it is about leading the people. Readable says what the pair means.

decisions.choice: "đi ra và đi vào" keeps the Hebrew pair
decisions.reason: B says "ra vào dẫn dắt anh em" and R "lãnh đạo", as the English levels explain the idiom.

decisions.choice: "나가고 들어오다" (L, B); "이끌다" (R)
decisions.reason: The pair means leading the people in war and daily life; Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew pair, Readable says what it means, as the English does.

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh your God, he [is] crossing before you; he will destroy the nations the these from before you, and you will dispossess them; Joshua, he [is] crossing before you, just as spoke Yahweh.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] the one crossing over before you; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua, he [is] the one crossing over before you, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} is the one who will cross over before you. He will wipe out these nations in your path, and you will drive them out. Joshua too will cross over at your head, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has said.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God will go across ahead of you. He will destroy these nations as you advance, and you will drive them out. Joshua will also go ahead of you, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} promised.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] el que pasa delante de ti; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} destruirá estas naciones de delante de ti, y tú las desposeerás. Josué, él [es] el que pasa delante de ti, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha dicho.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo cruzará delante de ti. Él aniquilará a estas naciones a tu paso, y tú las expulsarás. También Josué cruzará al frente de ti, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha dicho.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios irá delante de ti al otro lado. Él destruirá a estas naciones a medida que avances, y tú las echarás. Josué también irá delante de ti, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo prometió.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui passe devant toi ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui détruira ces nations de devant toi, et tu les déposséderas. Josué, c’est lui qui passe devant toi, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a dit.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu passera {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} devant toi. Il anéantira ces nations sur ton passage, et tu les chasseras. Josué aussi passera à ta tête, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a dit.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu va traverser devant toi. Il détruira ces nations à mesure que tu avanceras, et tu les chasseras. Josué aussi ira devant toi, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a promis.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ndiye] anayevuka mbele yako; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atayaangamiza mataifa haya mbele yako, nawe utawarithi. Yoshua, yeye [ndiye] anayevuka mbele yako, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} ndiye atakayevuka mbele yako. Atayaangamiza mataifa haya mbele yako, nawe utawafukuza. Yoshua naye atavuka akikuongoza, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atatangulia mbele yako kuvuka. Atayaangamiza mataifa haya unaposonga mbele, nawe utawafukuza. Yoshua pia atakutangulia, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoahidi.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là Đấng] đi qua trước ngươi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ tiêu diệt các dân tộc này khỏi trước mặt ngươi, và ngươi sẽ đuổi chúng đi. Giô-suê, chính người [là người] đi qua trước ngươi, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.B: Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em sẽ đi qua trước anh em. Ngài sẽ tiêu diệt các dân tộc này trên đường anh em đi, và anh em sẽ đuổi họ đi. Giô-suê cũng sẽ đi qua dẫn đầu anh em, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em sẽ đi qua sông trước anh em. Ngài sẽ tiêu diệt các dân tộc này khi anh em tiến lên, và anh em sẽ đuổi họ đi. Giô-suê cũng sẽ đi trước anh em, đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hứa.

ko.L: 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그분께서 네 앞에서 건너가실 것이다. 그분께서 이 민족들을 네 앞에서 멸하실 것이고, 너는 그들을 쫓아내고 [그 땅을] 차지할 것이다. 여호수아, 그가 네 앞에서 건너갈 것이니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로이다.
ko.B: 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 너희보다 앞서 건너가실 것이다. 그분께서 너희 앞에서 이 민족들을 멸하실 것이고, 너희는 그들을 쫓아내고 그 땅을 차지할 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 여호수아도 너희 앞에 서서 건너갈 것이다.
ko.R: 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분보다 먼저 강을 건너가실 것입니다. 그분께서 여러분이 나아가는 길에서 이 민족들을 멸하실 것이고, 여러분은 그들을 쫓아낼 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 약속하신 대로 여호수아도 여러분 앞에서 이끌며 건너갈 것입니다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] quem atravessa diante de ti; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} destruirá estas nações de diante de ti, e tu as desapossarás. Josué, ele [é] quem atravessa diante de ti, assim como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou.
pt.B: O próprio {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, atravessará à tua frente. Ele destruirá estas nações diante de ti, e tu as expulsarás. Josué também atravessará à tua frente, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, vai atravessar à tua frente. Ele vai destruir estas nações à medida que fores avançando, e tu vais expulsá-las. Josué também vai à tua frente, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} prometeu.

decisions.choice: he ... he: God himself goes first, and Joshua goes with the people
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets an emphatic "he" before God's crossing and another before Joshua's. God is the one who really goes ahead and wins the battles; Joshua leads the people under him. Moses' absence will not leave Israel without a leader.

decisions.choice: dispossess them: drive the nations out and take over what they held
decisions.reason: With nations as its object this verb means to drive them out and take their place (as in 9:1; 11:23). It is the same verb used for Israel taking possession of the land.

decisions.choice: as the LORD has spoken: God's appointment of Joshua
decisions.reason: God told Moses to appoint Joshua as his successor (Numbers 27:18-23) and to encourage him because he would lead the people across (1:38; 3:28).

decisions.choice: himself; "Joshua too" / "Joshua will also"
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the stress of the Hebrew "he" with "himself". "Too" and "also" show that Joshua goes ahead as well, under God.

decisions.choice: O próprio SENHOR (B), with only the name under the setting
decisions.reason: As in 3:22: Portuguese gives the stress of the Hebrew "he" (m1) with "o próprio", which is not a pronoun and takes no capital, where the English Balanced has "himself" under the capitalisation setting. The same in verse 8. The verse is singular, so every level says "tu", after the "vocês" of verse 2.

records.literal_gloss: And will do Yahweh to them just as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and to their land, whom he destroyed them.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will do to them just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} destroyed them.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will deal with them as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} dealt with Sihon and Og, the Amorite kings, and with their land, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} destroyed them.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will destroy them, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} destroyed Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, and their land.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les hará tal como hizo a Sijón y a Og, reyes de los amorreos, y a su tierra, cuando los destruyó.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará con ellos lo mismo que hizo con Sijón y Og, los reyes amorreos, y con su tierra, cuando los destruyó.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los destruirá, igual que destruyó a Sijón y a Og, los reyes de los amorreos, y su tierra.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur fera comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait à Sihon et à Og, les rois des Amoréens, et à leur pays, lorsqu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a détruits.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les traitera comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a traité Sihon et Og, les rois amoréens, ainsi que leur pays, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a détruits.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les détruira, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a détruit Sihon et Og, les rois des Amoréens, et leur pays.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatendea kama alivyowatendea Sihoni na Ogu, wafalme wa Waamori, na nchi yao, alipowaangamiza.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawafanyia kama alivyowafanyia Sihoni na Ogu, wafalme wa Waamori, pamoja na nchi yao, alipowaangamiza.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawaangamiza, kama alivyowaangamiza Sihoni na Ogu, wafalme wa Waamori, na nchi yao.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ làm cho chúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho Si-hôn và Óc, các vua của người A-mô-rít, và cho xứ của họ, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tiêu diệt họ.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đối xử với họ như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đối xử với Si-hôn và Óc, các vua A-mô-rít, cùng với xứ của họ, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tiêu diệt họ.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ tiêu diệt họ, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tiêu diệt Si-hôn và Óc, các vua của người A-mô-rít, cùng với xứ của họ.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 아모리 사람의 왕들인 시혼과 옥과 그들의 땅에 하셨던 것처럼, 곧 그들을 멸하셨던 것처럼, 그들에게도 그렇게 하실 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 아모리 사람의 왕 시혼과 옥과 그들의 땅을 멸하셨던 것처럼, 이 민족들에게도 그렇게 하실 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 아모리 사람의 왕 시혼과 옥과 그들의 땅을 멸하셨던 것처럼, 이 민족들도 멸하실 것입니다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fará a elas assim como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez a Seom e a Ogue, os reis dos amorreus, e à terra deles, quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os destruiu.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} tratará essas nações como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tratou Seom e Ogue, os reis amorreus, e a terra deles, quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os destruiu.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai destruir essas nações, assim como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} destruiu Seom e Ogue, os reis dos amorreus, e a terra deles.

decisions.choice: Sihon and Og: the two kings defeated east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Israel defeated Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan and took their land (2:26-3:11; Numbers 21:21-35). Those victories are proof of what God will do west of the river (3:21).

decisions.choice: whom he destroyed: the kings, with their land
decisions.reason: The closing clause looks back to the kings and their land together: God destroyed them and their rule.

source.text: וּנְתָנָ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָהֶ֔ם כְּכָל־הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will give them Yahweh before you, and you will do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will give them over before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment that I have commanded you.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will hand them over to you, and you must deal with them exactly as I have commanded you.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will let you defeat them. Then you must do to them everything I have commanded you.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los entregará delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} con ellos conforme a todo el mandamiento que {{plural_you:les|os}} he mandado.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:se los|os los}} entregará, y {{plural_you:deberán|deberéis}} tratarlos exactamente como {{plural_you:les|os}} he mandado.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dará la victoria sobre ellos. Entonces {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} que hacer con ellos todo lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} he mandado.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les livrera devant vous, et vous leur ferez selon tout le commandement que je vous ai commandé.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous les livrera, et vous devrez les traiter exactement comme je vous l’ai ordonné.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous donnera la victoire sur eux. Alors vous devrez leur faire tout ce que je vous ai ordonné.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatoa mbele yenu, nanyi mtawatendea sawasawa na amri yote niliyowaamuru.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatia mikononi mwenu, nanyi mtawatendea kikamilifu kama nilivyowaagiza.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawawezesha kuwashinda. Kisha lazima mwatendee kila kitu nilichowaamuru.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ phó chúng trước mặt các ngươi, và các ngươi phải làm cho chúng theo mọi điều răn mà tôi đã truyền cho các ngươi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ phó họ vào tay anh em, và anh em phải đối xử với họ đúng như mọi điều tôi đã truyền cho anh em.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ cho anh em đánh bại họ. Khi ấy anh em phải làm cho họ mọi điều tôi đã truyền cho anh em.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 너희 앞에 넘겨주실 것이니, 너희는 내가 너희에게 명령한 모든 명령대로 그들에게 하여라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 너희 손에 넘겨주실 것이니, 너희는 내가 너희에게 명령한 그대로 그들에게 하여라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 여러분이 그들을 이기게 하실 것입니다. 그러면 여러분은 제가 여러분에게 명령한 모든 것을 그들에게 그대로 하십시오.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} as entregará diante de vocês, e vocês farão a elas conforme todo o mandamento que eu lhes ordenei.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} as entregará a vocês, e vocês deverão tratá-las exatamente como eu lhes ordenei.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai dar a vocês a vitória sobre elas. Então vocês devem fazer com elas tudo o que eu ordenei a vocês.

decisions.choice: give them before you: put them in your power
decisions.reason: To "give" an enemy "before" someone is to let that person defeat them (2:33; 7:2, 23).

decisions.choice: all the commandment I have commanded you: the orders about the nations of the land
decisions.reason: "Commandment" is singular, the whole charge Moses has given. Here it points to the orders for dealing with the nations of the land: to make no covenant with them, to destroy their altars and to devote them to destruction (7:1-5; 20:16-18).

decisions.choice: exactly as / everything I have commanded
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "according to all the commandment". Balanced and Readable fold the singular noun into the verb, which says the same thing.

source.text: חִזְק֣וּ וְאִמְצ֔וּ אַל־תִּֽירְא֥וּ וְאַל־תַּעַרְצ֖וּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י׀יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ ה֚וּא הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יַעַזְבֶֽךָּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Be strong and be bold; do not fear and do not tremble from before them, for Yahweh your God, he [is] the [one] going with you; not he will let you drop, and not he will forsake you.

en.L: Be strong and be courageous; do not fear and do not tremble before them, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] the one who goes with you. He will not let you go, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not forsake you."
en.B: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid of them or tremble before them, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is the one who goes with you. He will not let you go, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not abandon you."
en.R: Be strong and brave! Do not be afraid of them or let them frighten you. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God is going with you. He will not let go of you, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not leave you on your own."

es.L: {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} fuertes y {{plural_you:sean|sed}} valientes; no {{plural_you:teman|temáis}} ni {{plural_you:tiemblen|tembléis}} delante de ellos, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] el que va contigo. No te soltará y no te desamparará».
es.B: {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} fuertes y valientes. No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo de ellos ni {{plural_you:tiemblen|tembléis}} ante ellos, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios es quien va contigo. No te soltará ni te abandonará».
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} fuertes y valientes! No {{plural_you:les tengan|les tengáis}} miedo ni {{plural_you:se dejen|os dejéis}} asustar por ellos. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} va con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. No {{plural_you:los|os}} soltará, y no {{plural_you:los|os}} dejará solos».

fr.L: Soyez forts et soyez courageux ; ne craignez pas et ne tremblez pas devant eux, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui marche avec toi. Il ne te lâchera pas et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne t’abandonnera pas. »
fr.B: Soyez forts et courageux. N’ayez pas peur d’eux et ne tremblez pas devant eux, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est celui qui marche avec toi. Il ne te lâchera pas et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne t’abandonnera pas. »
fr.R: Soyez forts et courageux ! N’ayez pas peur d’eux, ne vous laissez pas effrayer par eux. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu marche avec vous. Il ne vous lâchera pas, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne vous laissera pas seuls. »

sw.L: Iweni imara, mkawe hodari; msiogope wala msitetemeke mbele yao, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ndiye] anayekwenda pamoja nawe. Hatakuachilia, wala hatakutupa."
sw.B: Iweni imara na hodari. Msiwaogope wala msitetemeke mbele yao, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ndiye anayekwenda pamoja nawe. Hatakuachilia, wala hatakutupa."
sw.R: Iweni imara na jasiri! Msiwaogope, wala msiwaache wawatishe. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu anakwenda pamoja nanyi. Hatawaachilia, wala hatawaacha peke yenu."

vi.L: Hãy mạnh mẽ và can đảm; chớ sợ và chớ run rẩy trước mặt chúng, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là Đấng] đi với ngươi. Ngài sẽ không buông ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không lìa bỏ ngươi."
vi.B: Hãy mạnh mẽ và can đảm. Đừng sợ hãi hay run rẩy trước mặt họ, vì chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em là Đấng đi cùng anh em. Ngài sẽ không buông anh em ra, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không bỏ rơi anh em."
vi.R: Hãy mạnh mẽ và dũng cảm! Đừng sợ họ, cũng đừng để họ làm anh em khiếp sợ. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đang đi cùng anh em. Ngài sẽ không buông anh em ra, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không để anh em một mình."

ko.L: 너희는 강하고 담대하여라. 그들을 두려워하지 말고 그들 앞에서 떨지 말아라. 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그분께서 너와 함께 가시는 분이시다. 그분께서는 너를 놓지 않으시고 너를 버리지 않으실 것이다."
ko.B: 너희는 강하고 담대하여라. 그들을 두려워하지 말고, 그들 앞에서 떨지도 말아라. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희와 함께 가신다. 그분께서는 너희를 놓지 않으시고 버리지도 않으실 것이다."
ko.R: 여러분은 힘을 내고 용기를 가지십시오! 그들을 두려워하지 말고, 그들 때문에 겁내지도 마십시오. 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분과 함께 가십니다. 그분께서는 여러분을 놓지 않으시고, 여러분을 홀로 버려 두지도 않으실 것입니다."

pt.L: Sejam fortes e sejam corajosos; não temam e não tremam diante delas, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] quem vai contigo. Ele não te largará e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não te desamparará."
pt.B: Sejam fortes e corajosos. Não tenham medo delas nem tremam diante delas. Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, é quem vai contigo. Ele não te largará e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não te abandonará."
pt.R: Sejam fortes e corajosos! Não tenham medo delas, nem fiquem apavorados por causa delas. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, vai contigo. Ele não vai te largar, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não vai te deixar sozinho."

decisions.choice: be strong and be bold: stand firm and have courage
decisions.reason: The two verbs together are the charge to hold firm and act bravely in the face of danger. Moses gives it here to the whole people, and then to Joshua (verses 7, 23; 3:28; Joshua 1:6-9).

decisions.choice: let you drop: let go of you, loosen his hold
decisions.reason: The first verb means to let something fall slack, to let go of it. The second means to leave behind or abandon. Together they promise that God will not loosen his grip on his people or leave them on their own (verse 8; Joshua 1:5).

decisions.choice: you: the people, plural and then singular
decisions.reason: The commands are plural, spoken to all the people. "Your God" and "with you" are singular, as Deuteronomy often speaks to Israel as one person.

decisions.choice: let you go / let go of you
decisions.reason: The English keeps the picture of loosening a hold, which the Hebrew verb has, instead of a more general word such as "fail".

decisions.choice: plural commands ("sean", "no teman") then singular "tu Dios", "contigo" at Literal and Balanced; Readable keeps the plural through the verse ("su Dios", "con ustedes")
decisions.reason: Spanish can show the Hebrew shift from all the people to Israel as one (see the meaning decision); Readable keeps one number so the verse is easy to follow.

decisions.choice: "Soyez forts" (vous) then "ton Dieu", "avec toi" (tu) at Literal and Balanced; Readable keeps "vous" through the verse
decisions.reason: French follows the Hebrew number, as elsewhere in Deuteronomy; Readable keeps one number so the verse is easy to follow.

decisions.choice: "Iweni imara na hodari" (L, B), "Iweni imara na jasiri" (R) for "be strong and courageous"; the singular "Mungu wako", "nawe" follows the Hebrew at Literal and Balanced, Readable stays plural ("Mungu wenu", "nanyi")
decisions.reason: "imara" (firm) and "hodari" (bold) keep the two Hebrew verbs apart; "jasiri" is the plainer word for brave. The same pair is used for Joshua in verses 7 and 23.

decisions.choice: "강하고 담대하여라" (L, B); "힘을 내고 용기를 가지십시오" (R)
decisions.reason: The charge that runs through verses 6, 7 and 23 and on into Joshua 1; worded the same each time so the reader hears it repeat.

decisions.choice: "놓지 않으시고 ... 버리지 않으실 것이다"
decisions.reason: The first verb is to loosen one's hold; Korean keeps that picture with "놓다", so the promise is not just that God will stay but that he will not let go.

decisions.choice: Sejam fortes e (sejam) corajosos (to the people); Sê forte e corajoso to one person (verse 23); Seja forte e corajoso from Moses to Joshua (verse 7)
decisions.reason: For the whole chapter: the charge (m1) is "forte e corajoso" at every level, so that the people (here, plural), Joshua from Moses (verse 7) and Joshua from the LORD (verse 23) hear the same words; only the form of address changes. Literal repeats the second imperative as the Hebrew does. The commands are plural and "your God", "with you" singular (m3): Balanced and Readable put the promise in a sentence of its own, so that it keeps the singular "te".

decisions.choice: não te largará e não te desamparará (L); não te largará e não te abandonará (B); não vai te largar ... não vai te deixar sozinho (R)
alternatives: não te deixará nem te abandonará
decisions.reason: Hebrews 13:5 quotes this promise in the first person, and its Portuguese has "largar" at Literal and Readable, "desamparar" at Literal and "abandonar" at Balanced; Deuteronomy keeps those verbs where the Hebrew allows. "Largar" keeps the picture of loosening a hold (m2), as the English "let go" does; Readable's "deixar sozinho" follows the English Readable.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו לְעֵינֵ֣י כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֘לחֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָץ֒ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תָּבוֹא֙ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם וְאַתָּ֖ה תַּנְחִילֶ֥נָּה אוֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And called Moses to Joshua and said to him in [the] eyes of all Israel, be strong and be bold, for you will go with the people the this into the land which swore Yahweh to their fathers to give to them, and you will cause them to inherit it.

en.L: And Moses called Joshua and said to him in the sight of all Israel, "Be strong and be courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} swore to their fathers to give to them, and you shall cause them to inherit it.
en.B: Then Moses summoned Joshua and, with all Israel looking on, said to him, "Be strong and courageous. You are the one who will go with this people into the land {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} swore to their ancestors to give them, and you will divide it among them as their inheritance.
en.R: Then Moses called for Joshua. With all Israel watching, he said to him, "Be strong and brave. You will go with these people into the land {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} promised with an oath to give their ancestors. You will give it to them as their own.

es.L: Y llamó Moisés a Josué y le dijo a la vista de todo Israel: «Sé fuerte y sé valiente, porque tú entrarás con este pueblo en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juró a sus padres que les daría, y tú se la harás heredar.
es.B: Entonces Moisés convocó a Josué y, ante la mirada de todo Israel, le dijo: «Sé fuerte y valiente. Tú eres quien irá con este pueblo a la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juró dar a sus antepasados, y tú se la repartirás como herencia.
es.R: Después Moisés llamó a Josué. Delante de todo Israel le dijo: «Sé fuerte y valiente. Tú irás con esta gente a la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} prometió con juramento dar a sus antepasados. Tú se la darás para que sea suya.

fr.L: Et Moïse appela Josué et lui dit sous les yeux de tout Israël : « Sois fort et sois courageux, car c’est toi qui iras avec ce peuple dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a juré à leurs pères de leur donner, et c’est toi qui le leur feras hériter.
fr.B: Puis Moïse convoqua Josué et, sous le regard de tout Israël, lui dit : « Sois fort et courageux. C’est toi qui entreras avec ce peuple dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a juré à leurs ancêtres de leur donner, et c’est toi qui le leur partageras en héritage.
fr.R: Ensuite, Moïse a appelé Josué. Devant tout Israël, il lui a dit : « Sois fort et courageux. Tu vas aller avec ce peuple dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a promis par serment de donner à leurs ancêtres. C’est toi qui le leur donneras, pour qu’il soit à eux.

sw.L: Musa akamwita Yoshua, akamwambia mbele ya macho ya Israeli wote, "Uwe imara, uwe hodari, kwa maana wewe utakwenda pamoja na watu hawa katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaapia baba zao kwamba atawapa, nawe utawarithisha.
sw.B: Kisha Musa alimwita Yoshua, na Israeli wote wakitazama, akamwambia, "Uwe imara na hodari. Wewe ndiye utakayekwenda pamoja na watu hawa katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaapia mababu zao kwamba atawapa, nawe utawagawia iwe urithi wao.
sw.R: Kisha Musa alimwita Yoshua. Israeli wote wakiwa wanatazama, alimwambia, "Uwe imara na jasiri. Utakwenda pamoja na watu hawa katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliahidi kwa kiapo kuwapa mababu zao. Wewe utawapa nchi hiyo iwe yao.

vi.L: Và Môi-se gọi Giô-suê và nói với người trước mắt cả Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Hãy mạnh mẽ và can đảm, vì con sẽ đi với dân này vào xứ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thề với tổ phụ họ là sẽ ban cho họ, và con sẽ làm cho họ nhận được xứ ấy làm sản nghiệp.
vi.B: Rồi Môi-se gọi Giô-suê đến và nói với ông trước mặt toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Hãy mạnh mẽ và can đảm! Chính con sẽ đi với dân này vào xứ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thề với tổ tiên họ là sẽ ban cho họ, và con sẽ chia xứ ấy cho họ làm sản nghiệp.
vi.R: Rồi Môi-se cho gọi Giô-suê. Trước mặt toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, ông nói với Giô-suê: "Hãy mạnh mẽ và dũng cảm! Con sẽ đi với dân này vào xứ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thề hứa ban cho tổ tiên họ. Con sẽ ban xứ ấy cho họ làm đất riêng của mình.

ko.L: 그리고 모세가 여호수아를 불러 온 이스라엘의 눈앞에서 그에게 말하였다. "강하고 담대하여라. 너는 이 백성과 함께 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들의 조상들에게 주시겠다고 맹세하신 땅에 들어가서, 그들이 그 땅을 유산으로 받게 할 것이다.
ko.B: 그때에 모세는 여호수아를 불러, 온 이스라엘이 보는 앞에서 그에게 말하였다. "강하고 담대하여라. 너는 이 백성과 함께 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들의 조상들에게 주시겠다고 맹세하신 땅으로 들어가서, 그 땅을 그들에게 유산으로 나누어 줄 것이다.
ko.R: 그러고 나서 모세는 여호수아를 불렀다. 그리고 모든 이스라엘 백성이 보는 앞에서 그에게 말했다. "강하고 담대하여라. 너는 이 백성과 함께 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들의 조상들에게 주겠다고 맹세하며 약속하신 땅으로 들어갈 것이다. 너는 그 땅을 그들에게 나누어 주어 그들의 것이 되게 할 것이다.

pt.L: E Moisés chamou Josué e lhe disse aos olhos de todo o Israel: "Seja forte e seja corajoso, porque você entrará com este povo na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} jurou aos pais deles dar a eles, e você os fará herdá-la.
pt.B: Então Moisés chamou Josué e, diante de todo o Israel, lhe disse: "Seja forte e corajoso. É você quem vai entrar com este povo na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} jurou dar aos antepassados deles, e você a repartirá entre eles como herança.
pt.R: Então Moisés chamou Josué. Com todo o Israel olhando, disse a ele: "Seja forte e corajoso. Você vai entrar com este povo na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} prometeu com juramento dar aos antepassados deles. Você vai dar a terra a eles, para ser deles.

decisions.choice: in the sight of all Israel: a public commissioning
decisions.reason: Moses hands over the leadership before the whole people, so that everyone knows who will lead them and that he has Moses' authority (Numbers 27:19-20).

decisions.choice: cause them to inherit it: lead them in and share out the land
decisions.reason: As in 1:38 and 3:28, the verb means to give others an inheritance. Joshua will bring the people into the land and divide it among the tribes (Joshua 14:1).

decisions.choice: you will go with this people (the traditional Hebrew text)
alternatives: you will bring this people (Samaritan Pentateuch, some ancient translations)
decisions.reason: The traditional Hebrew text reads "you will go with this people". The Samaritan Pentateuch and some ancient translations read "you will bring this people", with the same verb God uses in verse 23. The difference is one small change of vowels and a letter. We follow the traditional text. This account of the evidence is from general knowledge and must be checked against the textual sources before review.

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "fathers", meaning forefathers. Balanced and Readable say "ancestors", as in 1:8.

decisions.choice: Moses calls Joshua "con", as in Numbers 11:29, where he is Moses' young aide
decisions.reason: An older leader to his assistant; Exodus 17:9 has Moses speak to Joshua without a pronoun of address, so this is the first place it is fixed.

decisions.choice: Moses speaks to Joshua in the plain style (해라체) with "너" at every level
decisions.reason: Joshua is Moses' younger assistant, now commissioned before the people; as master to servant in the Genesis sheet, Moses speaks down to him, and Readable keeps the same charge, "강하고 담대하여라", that God gives in verse 23.

decisions.choice: Seja forte e corajoso; você (Moses to Joshua)
decisions.reason: Moses speaks to Joshua man to man, so he says "você", as in 3:21 and as the book sets it at 1:6; "tu" is kept for the LORD's words to him in verse 23 ("Sê forte e corajoso"). The charge itself is the same words in both verses.

source.text: וַֽיהוָ֞ה ה֣וּא׀הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנֶ֗יךָ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑ךָּ לֹ֥א תִירָ֖א וְלֹ֥א תֵחָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh, he [is] the [one] going before you; he will be with you; not he will let you drop, and not he will forsake you; not you shall fear, and not you shall be dismayed.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] the one who goes before you; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be with you. He will not let you go, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not forsake you. Do not fear, and do not be dismayed."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} goes ahead of you, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be with you. He will not let you go or abandon you. Do not be afraid or lose heart."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} will lead the way for you. He will be with you. He will not let go of you or leave you on your own. So do not be afraid, and do not lose heart."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] el que va delante de ti; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estará contigo. No te soltará y no te desamparará. No temas y no te acobardes».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo va delante de ti, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estará contigo. No te soltará ni te abandonará. No tengas miedo ni te desanimes».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo te guiará en el camino. Él estará contigo. No te soltará ni te dejará solo. Así que no tengas miedo ni te desanimes».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui marche devant toi ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sera avec toi. Il ne te lâchera pas et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne t’abandonnera pas. Ne crains pas et ne te laisse pas abattre. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} marche {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} devant toi, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sera avec toi. Il ne te lâchera pas et ne t’abandonnera pas. N’aie pas peur et ne perds pas courage. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} ira devant toi pour te montrer le chemin. Il sera avec toi. Il ne te lâchera pas et ne te laissera pas seul. Alors n’aie pas peur et ne te décourage pas. »

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ndiye] anayekwenda mbele yako; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atakuwa pamoja nawe. Hatakuachilia, wala hatakutupa. Usiogope wala usifadhaike."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} anakutangulia, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atakuwa pamoja nawe. Hatakuachilia wala hatakuacha. Usiogope wala usivunjike moyo."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} atakuongoza njiani. Atakuwa pamoja nawe. Hatakuachilia wala hatakuacha peke yako. Basi usiogope, wala usikate tamaa."

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là Đấng] đi trước con; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ở với con. Ngài sẽ không buông con, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không lìa bỏ con. Chớ sợ, và chớ kinh hãi."
vi.B: Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đi trước con, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ở với con. Ngài sẽ không buông con ra, cũng không bỏ rơi con. Đừng sợ hãi, cũng đừng nản lòng."
vi.R: Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đi trước dẫn đường cho con. Ngài sẽ ở với con. Ngài sẽ không buông con ra, cũng không để con một mình. Vậy đừng sợ hãi, cũng đừng nản lòng."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그분께서 네 앞에서 가시는 분이시다. 그분께서 너와 함께 계실 것이다. 그분께서는 너를 놓지 않으시고 너를 버리지 않으실 것이다. 두려워하지 말고 낙심하지 말아라."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 네 앞에서 가실 것이고, 너와 함께 계실 것이다. 그분께서는 너를 놓지 않으시고 버리지도 않으실 것이다. 두려워하지 말고 낙심하지 말아라."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 네 앞에서 길을 이끄실 것이다. 그분께서 너와 함께 계실 것이다. 그분께서는 너를 놓지 않으시고 홀로 버려 두지도 않으실 것이다. 그러니 두려워하지 말고 낙심하지 말아라."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] quem vai diante de você; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estará com você. Ele não o largará e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não o desamparará. Não tema e não se assuste."
pt.B: O próprio {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} vai à sua frente, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estará com você. Ele não o largará nem o abandonará. Não tenha medo nem desanime."
pt.R: O próprio {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} vai guiar você. Ele estará com você. Ele não vai largar você nem deixar você sozinho. Por isso, não tenha medo nem perca a coragem."

decisions.choice: you: now Joshua alone
decisions.reason: Every "you" in this verse is singular and speaks to Joshua. He receives in person the promise Moses has just given to all the people in verse 6, almost word for word.

decisions.choice: be dismayed: be shattered, lose heart
decisions.reason: The verb means to be broken or shattered, and of people to be terrified or lose all courage (1:21; Joshua 1:9).

decisions.choice: himself
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the stress of the Hebrew "he" with "himself", as in verse 3.

decisions.choice: So
decisions.reason: Readable adds "So" to show that the commands follow from the promise.

source.text: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶת־הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּאת֒ וַֽיִּתְּנָ֗הּ אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י הַנֹּ֣שְׂאִ֔ים אֶת־אֲר֖וֹן בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶל־כָּל־זִקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And wrote Moses the law the this and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, the [ones] carrying the ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh, and to all [the] elders of Israel.

en.L: And Moses wrote this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and to all the elders of Israel.
en.B: Then Moses put this law in writing. He handed it to the priests, the descendants of Levi, who were the bearers of the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and to all of Israel's elders.
en.R: Moses wrote down this teaching. He gave it to the priests from the tribe of Levi, the men who carried the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He also gave it to all the leaders of Israel.

es.L: Y escribió Moisés esta ley y la dio a los sacerdotes, hijos de Leví, que llevaban el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y a todos los ancianos de Israel.
es.B: Entonces Moisés puso por escrito esta ley. Se la entregó a los sacerdotes, descendientes de Leví, encargados de llevar el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y a todos los ancianos de Israel.
es.R: Moisés escribió esta enseñanza. Se la dio a los sacerdotes de la tribu de Leví, los hombres que llevaban el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. También se la dio a todos los líderes de Israel.

fr.L: Et Moïse écrivit cette loi et la donna aux prêtres, fils de Lévi, qui portaient l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et à tous les anciens d’Israël.
fr.B: Puis Moïse mit cette loi par écrit. Il la remit aux prêtres, les descendants de Lévi, qui portaient l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et à tous les anciens d’Israël.
fr.R: Moïse a écrit cet enseignement. Il l’a donné aux prêtres de la tribu de Lévi, les hommes qui portaient l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il l’a aussi donné à tous les chefs d’Israël.

sw.L: Musa akaiandika sheria hii, akawapa makuhani, wana wa Lawi, waliolibeba sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na wazee wote wa Israeli.
sw.B: Kisha Musa aliiandika sheria hii, akawakabidhi makuhani, wazao wa Lawi, waliokuwa wabebaji wa sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na wazee wote wa Israeli.
sw.R: Musa aliyaandika mafundisho haya. Aliwapa makuhani wa kabila la Lawi, wanaume waliolibeba sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Aliwapa pia viongozi wote wa Israeli.

vi.L: Và Môi-se chép luật pháp này và trao nó cho các thầy tế lễ, là con cháu Lê-vi, những người khiêng hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và cho tất cả các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Sau đó Môi-se chép luật pháp này ra và trao cho các thầy tế lễ, con cháu Lê-vi, là những người khiêng hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và cho tất cả các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Môi-se chép lời dạy này ra. Ông trao nó cho các thầy tế lễ thuộc chi tộc Lê-vi, là những người khiêng hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ông cũng trao nó cho tất cả các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 모세가 이 율법을 기록하여, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤를 메는 레위의 자손 제사장들과 이스라엘의 모든 장로에게 주었다.
ko.B: 모세는 이 율법을 글로 써서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤를 메는 레위 자손 제사장들과 이스라엘의 모든 장로에게 주었다.
ko.R: 모세는 이 가르침을 글로 적었다. 그는 그것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤를 메는 사람들, 곧 레위 지파 제사장들에게 주었다. 그리고 이스라엘의 모든 지도자에게도 주었다.

pt.L: E Moisés escreveu esta lei e a deu aos sacerdotes, os filhos de Levi, que carregavam a arca da aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e a todos os anciãos de Israel.
pt.B: Então Moisés pôs esta lei por escrito. Ele a entregou aos sacerdotes, descendentes de Levi, que levavam a arca da aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e a todos os anciãos de Israel.
pt.R: Moisés escreveu este ensino. Ele o deu aos sacerdotes da tribo de Levi, os homens que carregavam a arca da aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Também o deu a todos os líderes de Israel.

decisions.choice: this law: the whole of Moses' teaching in this book
decisions.reason: As in 1:5, "law" is instruction: the whole body of Moses' teaching, history and appeal as well as rules. Now it is set down in writing (verse 24; 17:18).

decisions.choice: the priests who carried the ark
decisions.reason: The tribe of Levi was set apart to carry the ark (10:8), and in the crossing of the Jordan the priests carry it (Joshua 3:3). Giving the written law to the priests and the elders puts it in the care of both the religious and the civil leaders.

decisions.choice: teaching
decisions.reason: Readable says "teaching" for the Hebrew word Literal and Balanced render "law", as in 1:5.

decisions.choice: leaders
decisions.reason: Readable calls the elders "leaders", which says what they were: the senior men who led the tribes and towns.

decisions.choice: at the end of seven years: in the seventh year
decisions.reason: As in 15:1, "at the end of seven years" means in the last year of each seven, the year of release, not after it.

decisions.choice: the year of release: the seventh year, when debts were canceled
decisions.reason: Every seventh year Israelites were to release their fellow Israelites from debts (15:1-3). The same word is used of letting the land rest in the seventh year (Exodus 23:11).

decisions.choice: the festival of booths: the autumn harvest festival
decisions.reason: The festival was held for seven days after the harvest, at the place God would choose; the people lived in shelters made of branches to remember the wilderness journey (16:13-15; Leviticus 23:33-43). In the year of release the whole nation would be gathered there.

decisions.choice: the year when debts are canceled

decisions.choice: "el año de la remisión"

decisions.choice: "l'année de la remise"
decisions.reason: "Remise" (de dette) names the release of debts that marks this year (15:1-3); Readable says it plainly, "l'année où les dettes sont remises", as in 15:9.

decisions.choice: "mwaka wa maachilio"

decisions.choice: the place he will choose: the one place of worship
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy looks ahead to one place where God will put his name and where Israel will bring its offerings and keep its festivals (12:5; 16:16).

decisions.choice: to appear before the LORD
decisions.reason: The vowels of the traditional text read the verb as "to be seen", that is, to appear before the LORD, as in 16:16. The same consonants could be read "to see the face of the LORD". The sense is the same: the people come before God at his sanctuary.

decisions.choice: you shall read: singular
decisions.reason: "You" is singular. It may speak to Israel as one, or to the leader who will stand before the people. The reading was done by a leader in later times (Joshua 8:34-35; 2 Kings 23:2; Nehemiah 8:1-3).

decisions.choice: aloud ... so that they hear it
decisions.reason: "In their ears" means in their hearing. Balanced and Readable say the reading was aloud, for all to hear.

decisions.choice: stand before
decisions.reason: Readable says "stand before" for the less common "appear before".

decisions.choice: "낭독하여라" (L); "소리 내어 읽어 ... 듣게 하여라" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Joshua 8:34-35 in Korean, where the law is read aloud to the whole assembly.

decisions.choice: lerás, o teu Deus (tu); Reúne (verse 12)
decisions.reason: Moses gives the order to the priests and elders, but "you shall read" and "your God" are singular (m3), the address to Israel as one or to its leader; Portuguese keeps "tu", as the book does for the Hebrew singular, through verse 12. Verse 13 turns plural, "vocês".

decisions.choice: the little ones: the children
decisions.reason: The word means small children, those too young to march or fight. The whole community is gathered, not only the men.

decisions.choice: sojourner: a foreigner living among Israel
decisions.reason: The word names someone from another people who has settled among Israel without land of his own, and whom the law protects (10:18-19; 14:29). Such people also hear the law.

decisions.choice: fear the LORD and take care to do: reverence that shows in obedience
decisions.reason: To fear the LORD is to hold him in awe and respect, and Deuteronomy ties it to keeping his words (4:10; 6:2, 24). Hearing leads to learning, learning to fear, and fear to obedience.

decisions.choice: the outsiders who live in your towns
decisions.reason: "Sojourner" is uncommon in modern English. "Your gates" means your towns, whose gates were where public life went on.

decisions.choice: fear and honor
decisions.reason: Readable adds "honor" so that "fear" is not taken as mere terror, as in 17:19.

decisions.choice: o teu Deus (B)
decisions.reason: "Your God" is plural in the Hebrew, in a sentence otherwise singular. Literal follows it word by word and Readable, where it stands in a sentence of its own, keeps "o Deus de vocês"; Balanced keeps one form of address in the sentence, "tu".
